description: Candidate vision models for SKI-41. Edit this file to add or remove models; run.ts reads the ids from here. Every id below is a CANDIDATE and MUST be verified against https://openrouter.ai/models before the first paid run - OpenRouter ids change and a wrong id just returns HTTP 404, which the harness records as a 100% failure rate.

pricing.description: Fallback $/M-token table, used only when OpenRouter does not return a `usage` block for the call. Costs computed from this table are flagged `estimate: true` in the report. assumedPromptTokens/assumedCompletionTokens are the last-resort guess when even the token counts are missing: a ~1024px JPEG is roughly 1000-1600 image tokens plus the ~350-token system prompt, and the JSON verdict is short.
